view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with concrete flooring and high ceilings. Metal wire mesh cages on pallets line the space, some stacked. A red and black pallet jack is parked near one cage. Cardboard boxes sit on wooden pallets to the right. Blue metal racks and industrial equipment are visible in the background under fluorescent lighting.

objects.label: pallet jack
objects.observation: Red and black pallet jack with wheels, positioned on the left side of the frame. It has a black handle and is leaning against a metal cage. The jack's base rests on the concrete floor, partially obscuring its front wheels. No visible operator or motion.

objects.label: metal cage
objects.observation: Large, multi-tiered metal cage with wire mesh sides, located to the left of the pallet jack. It sits on a wooden pallet and contains white sacks. The cage is supported by its own frame and stands upright on the concrete floor. Partially obscured by the pallet jack.

objects.label: stacked metal cages
objects.observation: Two stacked metal cages, one blue and one red, positioned centrally in the background. They are mounted on wooden pallets and appear to be part of an organized storage system. The top cage is blue, the bottom is red, both with wire mesh. They stand independently on the concrete floor.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Several cardboard boxes stacked on wooden pallets, located on the right side of the image. The boxes are brown and show shipping labels. They rest directly on the pallets, which are on the concrete floor. Some boxes are stacked higher than others.

objects.label: blue metal rack
objects.observation: Blue metal rack with multiple levels, positioned behind the stacked cages. It appears to be a storage or workbench unit. The rack is freestanding on the concrete floor and extends into the background. Its structure is visible but partially obscured by other objects.

objects.label: industrial equipment
objects.observation: Large, dark blue coiled hoses or pipes, located behind the cardboard boxes on the right. They are resting on the concrete floor and appear to be part of industrial machinery or storage. Their exact function is unclear from this view.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33158", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
